strings.name: Eileen Gu
strings.summary: Raised in San Francisco, Gu began skiing as a child and represented China from 2019. Competing in halfpipe, slopestyle and big air, she won two golds and a silver at Beijing and one gold and two silvers in 2026, expanding freestyle skiing’s public reach. She also studied at Stanford and worked in fashion; her cross-border upbringing and team choice prompted identity debates.
strings.influence.rationale: Olympic champion and transnational sports-cultural figure, expanding public attention to freestyle skiing.
strings.facts.f2.value: International relations at Stanford; attended commencement in 2026.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Beijing: two golds and a silver
strings.highlights.h1.text: Medalled in all three freestyle skiing disciplines she entered in 2022.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Three more medals in Italy
strings.highlights.h2.text: Defended halfpipe gold in 2026 and won silver in the other two disciplines.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Stanford commencement
strings.timeline.t1.text: Attended Stanford commencement after the Olympic season.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Defended Olympic halfpipe
strings.timeline.t2.text: Won halfpipe gold plus slopestyle and big air silvers, reaching six medals across two Games.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Three medals in Beijing
strings.timeline.t3.text: Won big air and halfpipe gold, with slopestyle silver.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Two world titles
strings.timeline.t4.text: Won halfpipe and slopestyle titles plus big air bronze at the Aspen worlds.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Gold at X Games debut
strings.timeline.t5.text: Won two golds and a bronze at her first Winter X Games.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Youth Olympic medals
strings.timeline.t6.text: Won two golds and a silver at Lausanne’s Youth Olympics, gaining multi-event experience.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Began representing China
strings.timeline.t7.text: Announced she would represent China in international skiing.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in San Francisco
strings.timeline.t8.text: Born and raised in the US, beginning ski training around Lake Tahoe in childhood.
